name: gizza-ai/cartesian-product
summary: Generate every combination (tuple) across two to four input lists.

tool.description: Generate the cartesian product of two to four lists — every combination that takes one item from each list (e.g. sizes x colors x materials). Items inside each list are split by newline/comma/semicolon/pipe (auto-detected via item_separator), trimmed, blanks dropped, optionally deduped. Output one combination per line joined by join_separator (space/none/comma/dash/underscore/pipe/tab/custom) with optional prefix/suffix, or as CSV rows or a JSON array of arrays. The rightmost list varies fastest. max_combinations (default 10000, cap 100000) guards against exploding output.

custom_join_separator.description: Join string used when join_separator is 'custom', e.g. ' :: '.

dedupe.description: Remove duplicate items within each list before combining (keeps first occurrence).

item_separator.description: How items inside each list are split. 'auto' (default) tries newline, then comma, semicolon, pipe. Items are trimmed and blanks dropped.

join_separator.description: What joins the items of each combination in 'lines' output: space ' ', none '', comma ', ', dash '-', underscore '_', pipe '|', tab, or 'custom' (see custom_join_separator). Ignored for csv/json.

list1.description: First list. Items separated by newline, comma, semicolon or pipe (auto-detected unless item_separator says otherwise), e.g. 'red, blue, green'.

list2.description: Second list, same format as list1, e.g. 'S, M, L'.

list3.description: Optional third list, e.g. 'cotton, linen'. Leave empty to combine only two lists.

list4.description: Optional fourth list. Leave empty if unused.

max_combinations.description: Safety cap on the number of generated combinations (list sizes multiplied). Exceeding it is an error that reports the exact count. Default 10000, hard cap 100000.

output_format.description: 'lines' (default): one combination per line, items joined by join_separator. 'csv': one quoted CSV row per combination. 'json': JSON array of per-combination arrays.

prefix.description: Text prepended to every combination line ('lines' output only), e.g. 'sku-'.

suffix.description: Text appended to every combination line ('lines' output only), e.g. '-2026'.
